name: Naamah
loreTies: Source: Devils/demon kings (hierarchy, temptation, rulership, court violence)
shortBackstory: Naamah is the chainwarden breaker — the Devils-source whose court violence shatters what resists Infernal authority. The chaining is the breaking.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Naamah was born from the court — where power is not earned but taken. He is the breaker who shatters resistance through court-sanctioned violence. Ancient humans saw devils — but they saw the hierarchy and missed the violence. Naamah's chains do not just bind; they break.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Among the Infernal Dominion, Naamah ensures resistance is temporary. His chainwarden breaking shatters any defense that stands against Infernal authority. The breaking is always sanctioned by the court, which means it is always legal.

chapters.title: Gate Wound
chapters.text: The Mythos Gate wounded Naamah by making his chains wrap nothing. The Hollow removes what he was chaining — and chains that wrap emptiness are not restraints; they are just metal loops.

chapters.title: Campaign Role
chapters.text: In Cinders of Dominion, Naamah shatters enemy defenses through court-sanctioned violence. His chainwarden flail channels Infernal authority. But the Hollow removes the resistance — there is nothing to chain.

chapters.title: Personal Conflict
chapters.text: Naamah's flaw is that he has never encountered resistance he respected. All resistance is defiance, and all defiance is crime. The Hollow teaches him that some resistance is not defiance — it is survival.

relationshipHooks: Cross-faction envoys can challenge their doctrine without erasing their faction identity.
developmentStatus: Readable profile integrated into dashboard character pages.
mythological_sources: Asmodeus (Book of Tobit, Testament of Solomon)
human_echo: Asmodeus's destructive presence was the real lust-fury humans feared; the fish liver ritual was the human echo of his real weakness
